entities.name: Karl Bodenschatz
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Karl-Heinrich Bodenschatz was a German general who was the adjutant to Manfred von Richthofen in World War I and the liaison officer between Hermann Göring and Adolf Hitler in World War II.
